# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.mjs` is the unmodified ES module from `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`,
`package/dist/qrcode.mjs` in the npm release archive:
https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz

Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. MIT licensed; the upstream copyright and
license notice are retained at the top of the source. This is vendored source,
not a runtime package dependency. No QR data is sent to an external service.
